_why: Looping animations per surface, for `npm run check:animations` (`scripts/check_animation_budget.mjs`). The brief that rebuilt these surfaces allows one standout animated element per page; this file is the ratchet that keeps a surface from gaining a second. A number may only go up with a deliberate re-record and a sentence saying which element and why, and the printed list of surfaces above one is the debt to pay down.
